v2-1769077325691-1lbrqw217.name: Nova Prime
v2-1769077325691-1lbrqw217.description: A futuristic world characterized by colossal, abstract structures and advanced technology under vibrant skies.

v2-1769077325691-0mnz2i52j.name: The Great Construct
v2-1769077325691-0mnz2i52j.description: A region dominated by the colossal, abstract futuristic structure, serving as a hub of industrial exploration.

v2-1769077325691-av2zb43gv.name: The Central Pillar Observation Deck
v2-1769077325691-av2zb43gv.description: A white platform at the base of the colossal central pillar, offering a view of the immense, intricate structure.

v2-1769077916459-81m6ipeci.name: The Stellar Concourse
v2-1769077916459-81m6ipeci.description: A nexus of transport and public services within Nova Prime, the Stellar Concourse is a marvel of integrated urban design. It serves as a gateway for citizens and visitors, offering access to transit hubs and essential amenities.
forbiddenTransformations: Introducing organic or natural elements like plants, soil, or water features.
Adding historical or aged architectural styles incongruous with high-tech design.
Introducing elements that suggest weather or natural atmospheric conditions.
Depicting signs of decay, rust, or damage to the pristine surfaces.
Including any signage or elements that suggest a medieval or fantasy genre.
Adding vehicles or transport systems that are not futuristic or sleek.

v2-1769077916459-g2jzkbf3p.name: Main Concourse Hall
v2-1769077916459-g2jzkbf3p.description: The primary interior space of the Stellar Concourse, a vast hall characterized by soaring ceilings and polished surfaces. Luminescent panels and integrated displays guide travelers through the bustling hub.
forbiddenTransformations: Visible sky or exterior elements.
Exposed brick, wood, or rough-hewn stone textures.
Natural light sources like windows or skylights.
Visible ventilation shafts or conduits.
Any elements suggesting a domestic or residential space.
Decorations or art that are not integrated into the architectural design.
Visible signs of wear and tear on surfaces.

v2-1769080702061-58jfekxtl.name: Second Floor Indoor Balcony
v2-1769080702061-58jfekxtl.description: This enclosed space offers a unique vantage point from within the colossal central pillar. While an interior balcony, it maintains the structure's technological aesthetic with polished surfaces and subtle ambient lighting.
forbiddenTransformations: Introducing any windows that show the outside sky.
Allowing natural light sources to penetrate the space.
Showing any signs of damage, wear, or organic growth.
Adding furniture or decor not consistent with high-tech sterile environments.
Revealing the exterior construction or any hint of weather.
Creating large open voids that expose the full height of the structure; maintain the feeling of an enclosed space.

v2-1769083689173-o8vmzra0q.name: Evergreen Hills
v2-1769083689173-o8vmzra0q.description: A serene and adventurous landscape of towering evergreen trees on sun-drenched hillsides overlooking hazy valleys.

v2-1769083689173-utxzpsm86.name: Sun-Drenched Slope
v2-1769083689173-utxzpsm86.description: A hillside within Evergreen Hills, characterized by tall evergreen trees and a distant hazy valley view.

v2-1769083689173-6q34j8iup.name: Elaborate Treehouse Complex
v2-1769083689173-6q34j8iup.description: An elaborate treehouse complex with two distinct dwellings connected by bridges, featuring a larger shingled house and a smaller rustic house, a central platform, and a wooden deck with a hot tub at the base.

v2-1769083727319-2m5r1vosd.name: Elaborate Treehouse Complex
v2-1769083727319-2m5r1vosd.description: An intricate network of elevated dwellings nestled high in ancient evergreen trees, featuring a larger shingled house and a smaller rustic house, all connected by various wooden bridges. A central platform offers panoramic views, while a wooden deck with a hot tub sits invitingly at the complex's base.
forbiddenTransformations: Transforming the evergreen trees into deciduous trees or barren pines.
Adding urban structures or modern steel architecture to the complex.
Changing the golden hour lighting to harsh midday sun or nighttime.
Removing the connecting bridges or the central viewing platform.
Introducing non-wooden or non-natural building materials (e.g., plastic, concrete) for the structures.
Flattening the rolling hills or removing the dense evergreen canopy.
Altering the rustic, hand-built aesthetic of the dwellings to sleek, manufactured designs.

v2-1769083727319-pg2lvcoeb.name: Main Living Chamber
v2-1769083727319-pg2lvcoeb.description: The primary living space within the larger treehouse dwelling, characterized by its warm wooden interior and expansive windows offering filtered views of the surrounding evergreen canopy. This chamber serves as a cozy, elevated retreat, blending comfort with the adventurous spirit of arboreal living.
forbiddenTransformations: Introducing harsh, artificial overhead fluorescent lighting.
Replacing the natural wood interior with cold concrete or metallic surfaces.
Adding visible external structural elements or a central void/atrium within the room.
Decorating with futuristic, sterile, or overly minimalist furniture.
Removing the sense of being elevated and surrounded by nature.
Altering the warm, golden hour interior light to a stark, cold daylight or a dark, unlit interior.
Introducing highly contrasting or neon color palettes to the decor.
